mechanism_of_action: N-acetylgalactosamine-conjugated small-interfering RNA targeting liver-expressed HSD17B13 mRNA.
primary_endpoint: Frequency of adverse events; no timepoint specified.
efficacy_outcome: In Part B, liver HSD17B13 mRNA decreased dose-dependently, with a median reduction of 78% at 6 months in the 400 mg group.
safety_signal: In Part A, injection-site reactions occurred in 11% of rapirosiran-treated participants and were mild and transient; no treatment-related serious AEs. In Part B, COVID-19 occurred in 14% (5/36) and was deemed treatment-unrelated; no drug-induced liver injury was observed.
